hypothesis: Point-in-time foreign-ownership level, breadth, concentration and 20-day change measure internal ownership constitution and add stable 20-trading-day TWII direction beyond index trend and aggregate FinMind transaction flow.
decision_time: After date-t cash close and publication of date-t TaiwanStockShareholding.
target: TWII close direction from date t to 20 actual Taiwan cash-market trading days later.

data_semantics.point_in_time_universe: Four-digit common stocks with valid issued shares and foreign-ownership values on each source date; no current constituent list.
data_semantics.raw_persistence: Raw security rows are reduced to one immutable daily aggregate row and are not retained.

features: causal z-scores of valid stock count and valid fraction
median and IQR of stock-level foreign ownership ratio
zero, above-10%, above-20% and above-40% ownership breadth
top-10 foreign-share concentration and foreign-share HHI
median remaining investment ratio and restricted-upper-limit breadth
20-day changes in weighted ownership, median ownership, above-20% breadth and top-10 concentration
feature_transform: All 18 features use only date-t and earlier observations, standardized over a causal 252-row window with at least 126 rows.
method: 1512/252/252 nested ridge-abstention, 20-row purge at fit/validation boundaries, frozen lambda and confidence threshold for each following test block, and effective origins separated by at least 20 actual TWII rows.
formal_run_policy: Execute exactly once after this manifest. No result-dependent feature, threshold, date, horizon, subgroup or baseline changes are allowed.
promotion_policy: The foreign-shareholding treatment must pass every absolute gate, significantly beat the strongest simple baseline on identical dates, and significantly beat the index/aggregate control on common dates. Otherwise every foreign-shareholding directional coefficient remains zero.
